title: Wave 5: contract batch — version/roster, rules error partition, [introduced] honesty
description: Three contract-drift findings, one commit: (a) get_info() hardcodes "sutra v0.2.1" and lists 21 of 33 tools (Cargo.toml: 0.7.2; README claims 28) — misled this review's own pack build; (b) one malformed constraint in rules.toml silently disables ALL constraints in orient and guard (unwrap_or_default / fail-open) while sutra_review hard-errors — inconsistent contracts for the same human mistake on the durable tier; (c) review labels pre-existing violations from changed files as [introduced]. Findings: server-contract-drift, rules-error-silently-disables-constraints, review-introduced-label-overclaims (all MEDIUM). Locations: src/mcp.rs:990-998, src/tools/orient.rs:400, src/guard.rs:304-306, src/rules.rs:184-224, src/tools/review.rs:340-380.

acceptance_criteria.text: get_info uses env!(CARGO_PKG_VERSION); tool roster generated from the tool router, not hand-maintained prose

Rules::all_constraints partitions into (valid, errors); valid constraints enforced everywhere; errors surfaced as blocking-severity findings in orient/review/guard — no silent loss, no wholesale failure
[introduced] computed from merge-base actual imports, or label renamed until baseline is honest

execution_record:
Three commits landing all three findings:

1. 76d6b59 — get_info() uses env!(CARGO_PKG_VERSION) and generates tool roster from tool_router.map.keys(). README count corrected to 33, added missing sutra_add_root.

2. fce43db — Rules::all_constraints() returns (Vec<Constraint>, Vec<ConstraintParseError>) instead of Result. Valid constraints still enforced; parse errors surface as blocking findings in orient, guard, review, and constraints tools. Fail-open gap closed.

3. bc76546 — [introduced] label computed from merge-base actual imports via git show + parse_file. Only edges new in the diff are removed for baseline computation. Pre-existing violations no longer overclaimed.
